n: ISTE and ASCD AI Lessons in Spanish and Arabic
t: Five downloadable hands-on AI guides in English, Spanish, and Arabic.
steps: Open the ISTE and ASCD AI lessons page.
Follow the link to the download page.
Download the guide that fits your role.
Download the Spanish or Arabic edition if students need it.
Check the license and cost before you share copies.
Choose one unplugged project and print the materials.
Run the project and talk about the results.
